projects.name: Draw.Together
projects.description: Built a web application that combines text editing and diagram creation in one workspace. Added an interactive whiteboard with drawing and editing tools. Implemented secure JWT-based user authentication with Sign Up and Login functionality.

projects.name: Movie Recommender App
projects.description: Built a content-based movie recommendation system using Python. Used cosine similarity to recommend movies based on movie metadata. Integrated TMDB API to display movie posters, ratings, and details. Added filtering options for genre, release year, and rating.

projects.name: AI Resume Matcher
projects.description: Built a resume matching system to extract and analyze information from multiple resumes. Used Pydantic models to convert extracted information into structured data and compared resume information with job requirements.

experience.description: Contributed to the development of the official business website for pest control services with responsive and user-friendly UI design.

achievements: Secured 8th rank in CodeNexus organized by NIT Jamshedpur
